profile.headline: Software Engineer at Clark Associates
profile.summary:
I am a recent Master of Science in Computer Science grad with a background in psychology, Japanese, and 3+ years of work experience in international telecommunications. My career interests lie in software development and human-computer interaction. 

I have completed projects, like a collaborative painting application and a friends meet-up app, in languages including Python, C, and Java utilizing HCI techniques and object-oriented design principles. Last semester, I developed my skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other web development tools and developed an interactive dictionary website for word lovers.

I am passionate about problem-solving and love when my creations incite positive experiences for people. I believe my skill set and perspectives developed from my eclectic background will be useful in producing creative solutions for the real world and fulfilling user-focused needs.

positions.title: Media Production Assistant
positions.description:
• Supporting the Media Team on set to film media content for online courses
• Analyzing filmed content, then editing them using the Adobe Creative Suite to effectively communicate professors’ discourse to students

company.name: Boston College Center for Digital Innovation in Learning

positions.title: Network Analyst
positions.description:
• Collaborated with Network Operations Center (NOC) members to actively monitor and manage quality of the company’s global VoIP network performance
• Identified, analyzed, and resolved network problems
• Interfaced with external clients and internal commercial, routing, and engineering teams to articulate issues and potential solutions
• Operated the internal NOC website by researching, organizing, and writing procedures and training documents to promote expeditious team workflow
• Upheld communication within the NOC and with external teams through shift reports and team management software

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Analyzed and organized hundreds of articles regarding North Korean refugees, assimilation, acculturation,and multicultural students in South Korea
• Transcribed and translated Korean language interviews

positions.title: Japanese Tutor
positions.description:
• Assisted students with their Japanese language skills in speaking, writing, and vocabulary
• Communicated with professors to provide high-level support to students

positions.title: English Ministry Office Intern
positions.description:

• Assisted the pastor in everyday church matters, such as sermon preparations, PowerPoint presentations, and website updates via the CMS Joomla!

volunteerExperiences.description:
*also took part in 2013, 2012, and 2011

projects.title: StashBusters
projects.description: • Developed an Android application where users share photos of their craft supply stashes -- fabric, yarn, beads, paper, etc. -- and swap supplies and ideas for using them, boosting creativity and keeping craft materials out of landfills.

projects.title: Word Nerds
projects.description:
• Developed a web applications that serves as a community dictionary where users personally engage with words and enhance them with meaningful human input, such as personal definitions, example sentences, and favorite quotes.
• My role was building the frontend (React, HTML/CSS, Bootstrap)
